Synthetic LaTeX CVs for the LaTeX importer tests (T06). Every name, employer, address and
contact detail here is invented.

- `moderncv.tex`: moderncv personal-data macros, `\cventry`, `\cvitem`, `\cvlanguage`, an
  unsupported section, an image, a TikZ picture and an unknown command.
- `awesome/`: an awesome-cv main file that `\input`s section files, plus one include outside the
  folder and one missing include.
- `custom-macros.tex`: a plain `article` CV built from `\newcommand`s, in the style of the popular
  "Jake's resume" template.
